description: Trailing probe history for one server plus a daily uptime sparkline — the reliability signal behind the badge on mymcptools.com. Returns per-day uptime buckets and the raw probe points (timestamp, verdict, latency).

days.description: Uptime window width in days (default 14, max 90).

limit.description: Max raw probe points returned (default 30, max 200).

name: get_server_history
title: Get MCP server uptime history
